instruction: Fix `parse_ini` in `parselib/ini.py` so a repeated key in the same section keeps the *last* value. The current code uses `dict.setdefault`, so the first occurrence wins and later duplicate keys are silently ignored.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/parselib/ini.py b/parselib/ini.py
--- a/parselib/ini.py
+++ b/parselib/ini.py
@@ -27,5 +27,5 @@
             continue
         key, value = pair
         target = result if section is None else result[section]
-        target.setdefault(key, value)
+        target[key] = value
     return result
